title: Social Bias in Large Language Models For Bangla: An Empirical Study on Gender and Religious Bias
findings: Using template-based probing, all tested LLMs showed bias towards Hindus for positive traits, while GPT-4o showed significant bias towards Muslims for negative ideological traits. In naturally sourced probing, biases were less pronounced but still present, with GPT-4o and Llama-3 showing some bias towards Muslims. Template-based probing revealed more pronounced biases compared to naturally sourced contexts.
